_about: Posting queue read by the 'App marketing daily (posting)' task. Take the first item whose channel is due and whose status is 'queued'; set status and url after posting and add a row to marketing/POSTED.md. Captions must follow marketing/CAMPAIGN.md (claims bank).

reels.caption: Read your script right by the lens and keep eye contact. Cue: Teleprompter records with no watermark, and optional Cue Plus adds Voice Pace, which scrolls while you talk and waits when you pause. Now on Android, on Google Play.
Trace any photo onto real paper: stand your phone above the page, lock the picture and follow the lines with your own pencil. Linework: Trace & Sketch, on iPhone and Android. No ads, no subscription.

Say a line, hear it backwards, then try to copy that sound. Backspin flips your attempt forwards and scores it. Party mode for 2 to 8 players. Backspin: Reverse Your Voice, now on Android, on Google Play.

pins_next: Pinterest app pins are scheduled up to 22 Nov (see marketing/POSTED.md). Fill open 19:00 slots from new plan items: write them into marketing/pins/<slug>-live-2026-11.json (next ids CU-C03, BS-B03, LW-L06...), render, schedule.
